title: Sub-service Page
description: Drives the headless sub-service pages at /services/<service>/<sub-service>/. These fields are the page's only content source; anything left blank is not shown. Colours and the case-study category fall back to the parent service page's.

fields.label: Meta description
fields.name: meta_description
fields.instructions: Used for the meta description and social cards when the page has no AIOSEO description. Aim for 150-160 characters.

fields.label: Accent colour
fields.name: color_primary
fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the parent service page's accent colour (recommended, so every sub-service matches its service).

fields.label: Accent colour — light
fields.name: color_primary_light
fields.instructions: Blank uses the parent service's. Roughly 10-12% toward white from the accent.

fields.label: Accent colour — deep
fields.name: color_accent
fields.instructions: Blank uses the parent service's. Darker shade, used for eyebrows and small text on light sections.

fields.label: Breadcrumb label
fields.name: crumb_label
fields.instructions: Last item of the breadcrumb (Services / <service> / this). Blank uses the WordPress page title.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: hero_eyebrow
fields.instructions: Small caps line above the headline. e.g. "Performance Marketing & Search Engine Marketing · ABN Junction"

fields.label: Headline — part 1
fields.name: hero_heading_before
fields.instructions: e.g. "FROM"

fields.label: Headline — part 2 (accent colour)
fields.name: hero_heading_highlight
fields.instructions: e.g. "AD SPEND"

fields.label: Headline — part 3
fields.name: hero_heading_after
fields.instructions: e.g. "TO REAL GROWTH."

fields.label: Primary button label
fields.name: hero_cta_primary_label
fields.instructions: Dark button. Blank hides it.

fields.label: Primary button URL
fields.name: hero_cta_primary_url
fields.instructions: e.g. #campaign-lab or a full URL.

fields.label: Secondary button label
fields.name: hero_cta_secondary_label
fields.instructions: Outline button. Blank hides it.

fields.label: Secondary button URL
fields.name: hero_cta_secondary_url
fields.instructions: e.g. #offers

fields.label: Character artwork
fields.name: hero_image
fields.instructions: PNG on a white or transparent background (it is blended onto the cream hero). Alt text comes from the media library.

fields.label: Floating tags
fields.name: hero_tags
fields.instructions: Up to 3 pills floating around the artwork.

fields.label: Highlights strip
fields.name: hero_highlights
fields.instructions: Comma-separated, shown under the hero. e.g. "Google Ads & PPC, Campaign Strategy, Landing Page CRO"

fields.label: Row 1 keywords
fields.name: marquee_row_one
fields.instructions: Comma-separated. e.g. "GOOGLE ADS, META ADS, LEAD GENERATION"

fields.label: Row 2 keywords (accent colour)
fields.name: marquee_row_two
fields.instructions: Comma-separated, scrolls the other way.

fields.label: Menu location label
fields.name: rail_location
fields.instructions: Left of the sticky section menu, e.g. "DIGITAL MARKETING / PERFORMANCE"

fields.label: Challenge link
fields.name: rail_problems
fields.instructions: Blank leaves the section out of the menu. e.g. The Challenge

fields.label: Offers link
fields.name: rail_offers
fields.instructions: e.g. What We Offer

fields.label: Journey link
fields.name: rail_journey
fields.instructions: e.g. The Journey

fields.label: Lab link
fields.name: rail_lab
fields.instructions: e.g. Campaign Lab

fields.label: Approach link
fields.name: rail_difference
fields.instructions: e.g. Why ABN Junction

fields.label: Case studies link
fields.name: rail_cases
fields.instructions: e.g. Case Studies

fields.label: Related services link
fields.name: rail_related
fields.instructions: e.g. Related Services

fields.label: Insights link
fields.name: rail_insights
fields.instructions: e.g. Insights

fields.label: FAQ link
fields.name: rail_faq
fields.instructions: e.g. FAQs

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: problems_eyebrow
fields.instructions: e.g. 01 / The challenge

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: problems_heading
fields.instructions: One line per row; each line break shows as a line break on the page.

fields.label: Problem cards
fields.name: problems_items
fields.instructions: 3 fit the row. No cards hides the section.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: offers_eyebrow
fields.instructions: e.g. 02 / What we offer

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: offers_heading
fields.instructions: One line per row; each line break shows as a line break on the page.

fields.label: Expand button label
fields.name: offers_more_label
fields.instructions: e.g. What's included (a + is added)

fields.label: Collapse button label
fields.name: offers_less_label
fields.instructions: e.g. Show less (a − is added)

fields.label: Capabilities
fields.name: offers_items
fields.instructions: Numbered automatically. 6 fills two rows. No rows hides the section.

sub_fields.label: What's included
sub_fields.name: detail
sub_fields.instructions: Shown when the card is expanded. Blank hides the button.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: journey_eyebrow
fields.instructions: e.g. 03 / The signature experience

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: journey_heading
fields.instructions: One line per row; each line break shows as a line break on the page.

fields.label: Description
fields.name: journey_description
fields.instructions: Short line beside the heading.

fields.label: Scroll hint
fields.name: journey_scroll_hint
fields.instructions: e.g. SCROLL TO ADVANCE THE STORY →

fields.label: Story panels
fields.name: journey_slides
fields.instructions: The pinned scroller slides through these. The scroll length follows the count; 5-6 works best. No panels hides the section.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: lab_eyebrow
fields.instructions: e.g. 04 / The interactive campaign lab

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: lab_heading
fields.instructions: One line per row; each line break shows as a line break on the page.

fields.label: Heading — last line (accent colour)
fields.name: lab_heading_highlight
fields.instructions: e.g. YOUR GAME PLAN.

fields.label: Steps
fields.name: lab_steps
fields.instructions: The questions visitors answer. Each answer is sent with their enquiry. No steps hides the whole lab.

sub_fields.label: Question
sub_fields.name: question
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. What do you want your campaigns to achieve?

sub_fields.label: Preview tile label
sub_fields.name: kpi_label
sub_fields.instructions: Shows the answer as a tile in the live preview, e.g. Channels / Monthly ad budget. Blank shows no tile.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Optional glyph or emoji before the label.

sub_fields.label: Preview tile value
sub_fields.name: kpi
sub_fields.instructions: Short form for the tile, e.g. Google. Blank uses the label.

sub_fields.label: Plan title
sub_fields.name: plan_title
sub_fields.instructions: Sets the preview's plan title when picked, e.g. Your lead generation game plan.

sub_fields.label: Plan sentence
sub_fields.name: plan_text
sub_fields.instructions: Added to the plan when picked. Sentences from all steps are joined with "; ", so start lower-case after the first step.

sub_fields.label: Funnel outcome
sub_fields.name: outcome
sub_fields.instructions: Replaces the funnel's last stage when picked, e.g. PURCHASE.

sub_fields.label: Per-day tile label
sub_fields.name: range_per_day_label
sub_fields.instructions: Adds a tile showing the value ÷ 30, e.g. Daily average. Blank shows none.

sub_fields.label: Plan sentence
sub_fields.name: range_plan_text
sub_fields.instructions: Added after the plan; {value} becomes the slider value. e.g. Your {value} monthly budget is an input for planning, not a prediction of leads or revenue.

fields.label: Preview title
fields.name: lab_preview_title
fields.instructions: e.g. ✦ ABN CAMPAIGN CONTROL ROOM

fields.label: Preview badge
fields.name: lab_preview_badge
fields.instructions: e.g. LIVE PREVIEW

fields.label: Chart label
fields.name: lab_chart_label
fields.instructions: e.g. CAMPAIGN JOURNEY / ILLUSTRATION

fields.label: Funnel stages
fields.name: lab_funnel
fields.instructions: Comma-separated. The last stage is replaced by the picked option's outcome. e.g. AD IMPRESSION, CLICK, LANDING PAGE, LEAD

fields.label: Default plan title
fields.name: lab_plan_title
fields.instructions: Used when no picked option sets one.

fields.label: Default plan text
fields.name: lab_plan_text
fields.instructions: Used when no picked option adds a sentence.

fields.label: Plan button label
fields.name: lab_cta_label
fields.instructions: Opens the enquiry form, e.g. Get My Campaign Plan ↗. Blank hides the form.

fields.label: Replay link label
fields.name: lab_replay_label
fields.instructions: Links back to the journey, e.g. Replay the story ↑

fields.label: Contact Form 7 form ID
fields.name: lead_form_id
fields.instructions: Blank uses the site's shared enquiry form (12775). Another form must use the same field names: your-name, your-email, your-phone, your-company, your-message, services.

fields.label: "Services" value
fields.name: lead_services_label
fields.instructions: What the enquiry's services field says. Blank uses "<service> / <this page>".

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: lead_eyebrow
fields.instructions: e.g. Your campaign brief is ready

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: lead_heading
fields.instructions: e.g. Let's turn your plan into a conversation.

fields.label: Description
fields.name: lead_description
fields.instructions: e.g. Your campaign selections will be included in the enquiry.

fields.label: Consent checkbox text
fields.name: lead_consent
fields.instructions: Blank hides the checkbox.

fields.label: Submit button label
fields.name: lead_submit_label
fields.instructions: e.g. Send My Campaign Brief ↗

fields.label: Success message
fields.name: lead_success_message
fields.instructions: Blank uses Contact Form 7's own message.

fields.label: Error message
fields.name: lead_error_message
fields.instructions: Shown when sending fails or is flagged as spam. Worth including a direct email address.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: diff_eyebrow
fields.instructions: e.g. 05 / The ABN Junction approach

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: diff_heading
fields.instructions: One line per row; each line break shows as a line break on the page.

fields.label: Artwork
fields.name: diff_image
fields.instructions: PNG on a white or transparent background. Blank lays the copy out full width.

fields.label: Artwork label
fields.name: diff_image_label
fields.instructions: e.g. PERFORMANCE, WITH A PLAN ✳

fields.label: Show case studies from
fields.name: cases_category
fields.instructions: Blank uses the parent service page's category, then any category. The two most recent are shown; none hides the section.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: cases_eyebrow
fields.instructions: e.g. 06 / Proof in action

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: cases_heading
fields.instructions: One line per row; each line break shows as a line break on the page.

fields.label: Card label
fields.name: cases_card_label
fields.instructions: e.g. SELECTED CASE STUDY

fields.label: Card link label
fields.name: cases_link_label
fields.instructions: e.g. Explore this case study ↗

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: related_eyebrow
fields.instructions: e.g. 07 / The connected growth system

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: related_heading
fields.instructions: One line per row; each line break shows as a line break on the page.

fields.label: Service cards
fields.name: related_items
fields.instructions: 4 fill the row. Cards without a URL are dropped.

fields.label: Show posts from
fields.name: insights_category
fields.instructions: Blog category for the three posts. Blank (or an empty category) shows the latest posts.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: insights_eyebrow
fields.instructions: e.g. 08 / From the people doing the work

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: insights_heading
fields.instructions: One line per row; each line break shows as a line break on the page. The typing word follows the last line.

fields.label: Typing words
fields.name: insights_heading_switch
fields.instructions: Comma-separated; the heading's last word types through these. e.g. SEARCH, AD AUCTION, FUNNEL, DATA

fields.label: Card link label
fields.name: insights_link_label
fields.instructions: e.g. Read article →

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: faq_eyebrow
fields.instructions: e.g. 09 / Real questions, useful answers

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: faq_heading
fields.instructions: One line per row; each line break shows as a line break on the page.

fields.label: Questions
fields.name: faq_items
fields.instructions: The first one starts open.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: final_eyebrow
fields.instructions: e.g. 10 / Let's build what comes next

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: final_heading
fields.instructions: One line per row; each line break shows as a line break on the page.

fields.label: Button URL
fields.name: final_cta_url
fields.instructions: e.g. https://abnjunction.com/contact-us/ or #campaign-lab
